subcategory: 1590 CE Seven-Storey Red Sandstone Architectural Marvel
description: Constructed in 1590 by Raja Man Singh of Amber under the guidance of Rupa Goswami, a monumental red sandstone temple combining Hindu, Jain, and medieval European vaulted architectural elements.
why_visit: Gaze at the magnificent carved stone lotus ceiling vault, admire medieval red sandstone craftsmanship, and experience deep Vaishnavite heritage.
activities: Medieval Temple Architecture Tour; Vault Photography; Radha-Krishna Puja
notes: A protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).

place_name: Bankey Bihari Temple & Vrindavan Holy Heritage
description: The holy pilgrimage town where Lord Krishna spent his childhood, featuring the world-famous Bankey Bihari Temple founded by Swami Haridas, Prem Mandir, ISKCON Krishna Balaram Mandir, and Nidhivan.
why_visit: Witness the mesmerizing curtain-drawn darshan of Thakur Bankey Bihari Ji, attend illuminated evening water fountain shows at Prem Mandir, and walk the holy Yamuna Keshi Ghat.
activities: Bankey Bihari Darshan; Yamuna Boat Ride; Evening Prem Mandir Illumination; Peda Sweet Tasting
notes: Famous for ecstatic celebrations of Holi (Phoolon ki Holi) and Janmashtami.

subcategory: Birthplace Prison Cell of Lord Krishna
description: The sacred epicenter of Mathura venerated as the exact underground prison cell (Garbha Griha) where Lord Krishna was born to Devaki and Vasudeva over 5,000 years ago, alongside the Keshavdeva temple and Potra Kund.
why_visit: Descend into the sacred subterranean Garbha Griha cave shrine, admire exquisite marble temple carvings, and take holy water sprinkles at historic Potra Kund.
activities: Janmabhoomi Darshan; Underground Cave Visit; Holy Kund Walking; Mathura Peda Buying
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: Central Mathura, 2 km from Mathura Junction
notes: Strict security protocol; electronic devices and bags not permitted inside the sanctum.
